artboards.title: The audit — the same job, drawn too many ways

annotations.text: Read Main first (the diagnosis and the four directions), then the Audit (the evidence, drawn), then the four directions below. Each direction redraws the same two surfaces — the shop home and Gear — for the same shop on the same morning, so they compare like for like.

The pick is the owner's (H-71). Nothing here is normative until the ADR moves to Accepted. Direction A is the floor every other direction also has to clear; B, C and D each replace the surface and keep A's deletions.
